propositions: Incomplete retirement leaves exact identity live and retired simultaneously when crash occurs after tombstone replacement but before live replacement, detectable and safely completable only at write-bearing boundaries.
Recovery must require exact agreement of local id and Jira key across tombstone, forward entry, and reverse entry; any mismatch or corruption safety-aborts without mutation.
Retirement completion must execute once, between under-lock staleness validation and first remote issue fetch, before any write-bearing artifact creation or remote observation.
Explicit unretire removes tombstone intent and prevents completion; later automatic 200/clear_absent/same-key confirm does not implicitly resurrect a tombstoned identity.
Construction, load, reconcile-check, dry-run, preview, and filtered runs must perform zero writes from the retirement-completion operation.
Production code must not mutate bindings obtained from all_bindings(); rich-text handler must use narrow facade operation.
